about_h1_1: Our Story - Over 20 Years of Excellence
about_h3_8: Reliable renovation contractor in Israel bringing vision to life
about_p_20: Renovations 2000 was founded in 2000 with a clear vision - to be a reliable renovation contractor in Israel providing professional, quality and dependable service to private, commercial and institutional clients. Since its establishment, the company has grown and developed, but our core values have remained the same - professionalism, reliability, quality and personal service.
about_p_21: Over the years, we have completed hundreds of renovation projects - from small bathroom renovations to comprehensive general renovations of large homes and offices. Every project, regardless of its size, receives the same level of attention, professionalism and commitment to quality. We believe our reputation is built project by project, client by client, which is why we treat every job as if it were our most important project.
about_p_22: One of our main areas of expertise is bathroom renovation. We understand that the bathroom is a personal and intimate space, and its renovation requires precise planning, professional execution and attention to small details. Therefore, we invest time in understanding the client's needs and desires, offer creative and designed solutions, and execute the work to the highest standard.
about_p_23: We are committed to keeping our promises - schedules, budgets and quality. Reliability is the foundation of every customer relationship, and we do everything to maintain your trust.
about_p_24: We use only quality materials and work with skilled professionals. We don't compromise on quality because we know our work needs to stand the test of time.
about_p_25: Every client is unique, and every project requires a personalized approach. We listen to your needs and offer solutions that are perfectly suited to you.
about_p_26: We believe in open and transparent communication. You will always know what's happening in the project, what the costs are, and what the timeline is. No unpleasant surprises.
about_p_27: We respect your time and commit to meeting agreed deadlines. Precise planning and professional project management ensure the project is completed on time.
about_p_28: We stand behind our work and provide full warranty for all projects. Even after project completion, we're here for you.
about_p_29: The success of every renovation project depends on the people who execute it. Therefore, we invest greatly in building a professional, skilled and committed team. Our team includes experienced project managers, interior designers, certified subcontractors and expert professionals in all renovation fields - plasterers, painters, electricians, plumbers, carpenters, flooring specialists and more.
about_p_30: Every team member undergoes continuous professional training and is committed to our values - professionalism, quality and service. We believe a good team is the foundation for success, so we ensure that each of our team members feels valued and receives the tools and support needed to do the job in the best possible way.
about_p_31: We believe every renovation project is an opportunity to create something special. Therefore, we start every project with an in-depth consultation meeting where we get to know the client, understand their needs and vision, and offer customized solutions. We don't believe in 'one size fits all' solutions - every project is unique and requires a tailored approach.
about_p_32: Our process includes precise and detailed planning of all project phases, preparation of a transparent and detailed quote that includes all costs, professional project management that includes coordination of all contractors and suppliers, close quality control at every stage, and open and ongoing communication with the client. We believe good communication is the key to every project's success, so we ensure to update the client at every stage and be available for any question or request.
about_p_33: We also place great emphasis on material quality and execution. We work only with leading suppliers and use quality materials that guarantee durability for years. All work is performed according to the strictest standards, and we conduct thorough quality checks before delivering the project to the client.
about_p_34: Over 20 years of experience executing hundreds of renovation projects for the private, commercial and institutional sectors. We know every detail of the renovation process.
about_p_35: We offer fair and competitive prices with no hidden costs. Complete transparency from start to finish.
about_p_36: We stand behind our work and provide full warranty for all projects. If there's a problem, we're here to solve it.
about_p_37: Every client receives personal and attentive treatment. We're not just a contractor - we're your partners in realizing your vision.

our_work_h3_7: Bathroom Renovation - From Concept to Completion
our_work_p_15: Welcome to the project gallery of שיפוצים 2000. Here you can get an impression of the wide range of work we have performed for our clients, from luxury bathroom renovations to complete apartment renovations. We believe that every project is our business card, which is why we invest maximum effort in every detail.
our_work_p_16: In the construction and renovation industry, quality is measured not only by the final result visible to the eye, but also by what is hidden beneath the surface. As a leading company in the field, we insist on using the highest quality materials and working according to the most stringent standards. Whether it's replacing plumbing infrastructure, complex electrical work, or precise tiling, we don't compromise on anything less than excellence.
our_work_p_17: The projects displayed on this page demonstrate our ability to handle both engineering and design challenges. Our goal is to provide every client with peace of mind and confidence that they made the right choice. When you're looking for a reliable renovation contractor in Israel, experience and field results are the best measure of quality.
our_work_p_18: One of the impressive projects we recently completed included a comprehensive renovation of a bathroom in an old apartment in Tel Aviv. The challenge was to transform a small, dark, and outdated space into a modern and luxurious spa room. The process began with complete demolition of the room down to the foundation, including removal of old coverings and disposal of waste to an authorized site.
our_work_p_19: In the infrastructure stage, we performed a complete replacement of the water pipes with insulated and quality SP piping, and upgraded the drainage system to prevent future blockages. The waterproofing issue received special emphasis with the use of advanced two-component waterproofing materials, to ensure durability for many years without leaks.
our_work_p_20: Variety of renovation work we performed in the private and commercial sectors
our_work_p_21: Total renovation of a 4-room apartment. The project included breaking walls to create an open public space (Open Space), replacing flooring with 80x80 porcelain granite, decorative gypsum work on the ceiling and artistic painting. The apartment was transformed from a dark and divided apartment to a modern and bright one.
our_work_p_22: The kitchen is the heart of the home, and in this project we focused on creating a functional and designed kitchen. We performed complex preparations for plumbing and electricity for advanced electrical appliances, installed luxury glass wall covering and performed hidden lighting work to complete the atmosphere.
our_work_p_23: Adaptation of office space for a high-tech company. The project required meeting particularly tight schedules to allow the company to return to quick operation. We built acoustic gypsum partitions, installed suspended ceilings and laid wall-to-wall carpets. Precise and clean execution.
our_work_p_24: Choosing a renovation contractor is one of the most important decisions you'll make in the home upgrade process. The market is full of promises, but at שיפוצים 2000 we understand that the real proof is in the field. The extensive experience we've gained over the years allows us to anticipate problems in advance, offer creative solutions, and save our clients money and heartache.
our_work_p_25: We insist on complete transparency with the client. Our price quote is detailed and clear, without last-minute 'surprises'. When we commit to a schedule, we do everything to meet it, understanding that renovation is a stressful period for the household and we want to shorten it as much as possible without compromising work quality.
our_work_p_26: Our team consists of experienced and certified professionals in their fields - plumbers, electricians, flooring specialists and painters of the highest caliber.
our_work_p_27: We work only with materials that meet Israeli and international standards, ensuring durability for years and an aesthetic appearance that is maintained over time.
our_work_p_28: All our work is backed by full warranty. We're here even the day after the renovation, for any question or need that arises.
our_work_p_29: Our team is available for initial consultation without obligation. Let's turn your vision into reality together.

services_p_13: Bathroom renovation is one of our core specialties. We provide professional and comprehensive service that includes precise planning, safe demolition of existing structures, installation of new plumbing systems, quality tile flooring and wall covering, installation of modern bathroom fixtures, designer lighting, and finishing work of the highest standard.
services_p_14: As a reliable renovation contractor in Israel, we understand that every bathroom renovation project is unique. Therefore, we offer an initial consultation meeting where we listen to your needs, measure the space, and propose design and functional solutions that fit your budget and personal style. We work with leading suppliers and use only quality materials that guarantee durability for years to come.
services_p_15: Our process includes preparing a detailed and transparent quote that includes all renovation costs, a clear and detailed timeline, and close supervision throughout all project phases. We are committed to meeting deadlines and delivering perfect results that exceed your expectations.
services_p_16: The kitchen is the heart of the home, and kitchen renovation requires professional and precise planning. We specialize in planning and building new kitchens or renovating existing ones, with emphasis on functionality, design, and quality. Our service includes custom kitchen planning, installation of quality cabinets, durable and designer work surfaces, professional plumbing, electrical appliance connections, smart lighting, and perfect finishing work.
services_p_17: We work with experienced interior designers and kitchen consultants to ensure your new kitchen will be not only beautiful but also practical and convenient for daily use. We offer a wide range of design styles - from modern and minimalist kitchens to classic and traditional kitchens.
services_p_18: In the renovation process, we emphasize the quality of materials and execution. We use durable cabinets made from solid wood or quality MDF, work surfaces from Corian, granite or quartz, and quality finishing materials that guarantee durability for many years.
services_p_19: We provide comprehensive general renovation services for apartments, private homes, offices, and public buildings. Our service includes all required renovation work - plastering and painting walls and ceilings, flooring and covering, electrical and lighting work, plumbing work, installation of doors and windows, drywall and acoustic ceilings, carpentry and woodwork, and all required finishing work.
services_p_20: As a reliable renovation contractor in Israel, we understand that a general renovation project requires professional coordination between numerous professionals. Therefore, we provide professional project management that includes coordinating all contractors and suppliers, close quality control, meeting deadlines, and ongoing client reporting.
services_p_21: We work with a permanent team of skilled professionals - plasterers, painters, electricians, plumbers, carpenters, and more. Each is an expert in their field and committed to the highest quality and professionalism. The result is a renovation project that finishes on time, on budget, and with excellent quality.
services_p_22: We also specialize in renovations for the commercial and institutional sectors - offices, stores, restaurants, hotels, clinics, and schools. We understand the special needs of businesses and institutions - fast and efficient work, minimal disruption to ongoing operations, compliance with standards and regulations, and professional results that convey quality and reliability.
services_p_23: Our service for the commercial sector includes professional planning suited to the specific needs of the business, fast and efficient execution that minimizes disruption to operations, use of quality and durable materials suitable for intensive use, compliance with all relevant standards and regulations, and full warranty for the work.
services_p_24: We understand that time is money in the business world, so we commit to meeting agreed timelines and delivering perfect results with maximum speed. We also offer the option to work non-standard hours - nights or weekends - to minimize impact on the business's ongoing operations.
services_p_25: Electrical and lighting work are an integral part of every renovation project. We provide professional electrical services that include electrical system planning, installation of new electrical panels, electrical infrastructure layout, installation of electrical and communication points, installation of designer and functional lighting, and installation of smart systems.
services_p_26: We work with licensed and experienced electricians who thoroughly know all standards and regulations. We ensure professional and safe execution of all electrical work and provide full warranty for the work. We also offer professional consultation regarding lighting planning - where to place light points, what type of lighting to choose, and how to create a pleasant and functional atmosphere.
services_p_27: Professional plumbing work is critical to the success of any renovation project. We provide comprehensive plumbing services that include plumbing system planning, replacement of old piping, installation of hot and cold water systems, installation of quality plumbing fixtures, and solving complex plumbing problems.
services_p_28: We work with licensed and experienced plumbers who thoroughly know all types of plumbing systems. We ensure the use of quality and durable materials, professional execution according to all standards, and thorough testing after installation to ensure the system works perfectly.
services_p_29: Designer drywall ceilings can completely transform the look and feel of any space. We specialize in designing and installing stunning drywall ceilings - acoustic ceilings, ceilings with recessed lighting, tiered and designer ceilings, and drywall partitions for space division.
services_p_30: We work with skilled drywall specialists who specialize in creating complex and designer ceilings. We offer professional consultation regarding ceiling design, lighting integration, and choosing the appropriate finish. The result is a stunning ceiling that gives the space a completely new dimension.
services_p_31: One of the most common questions we receive is 'What is the cost of bathroom renovation?' The answer depends on several factors - the size of the bathroom, level of finish and materials, scope of required work, and whether it's a partial or comprehensive renovation. In the initial consultation meeting, we prepare a detailed and transparent quote that includes all costs, so you know exactly what you're getting and at what price.
services_p_32: We believe in complete transparency and providing real value to our customers. Therefore, we offer fair and competitive prices, with no hidden costs or unpleasant surprises. We also offer flexible payment options and adapt the solution to your budget.
services_p_33: Contact us today for free consultation and a detailed quote. We're here to turn your dream into reality.
